No sampled values become Stats counts. Shared library/artist/session validation is reused; no generic pagination framework or configuration option.

Authenticated empty readiness/consumer zeros remain valid; null representative song counts fail after four reads. Homarr still rejects oversized totals after four reads and fully reconciles 503 albums over 500+3 returned albums, yielding 1 artist, 503 albums, 503 songs and 0 sessions. No delays or new test files/functions/named cases.

Both fresh independent SOURCE reviews pass with zero findings at f343928008783ce6cc9b2e58f82ed6e378382631 against fixed dce263ef822dc056558a648f8f59ea795a3e56d9. All findings are resolved: saved Homarr public identity is checked before widget queries; Homarr-only album limits no longer fail standalone readiness; standalone Check uses six fresh authenticated schema-valid requests and one single-album page, without returning sampled Stats or enumerating the full library. Full local gate reported passed; reviewers did not rerun it. Keep draft: frozen-common normalization/registration and real native/rendered, both-order, credential-change and shared lifecycle acceptance remain outstanding; #284 stays open.
